_readme: Figma Variables payload in the shape of the REST API POST /v1/files/:file_key/variables (variableCollections, variableModes, variables, variableModeValues). The REST API needs an Enterprise plan; on other plans import tokens/tokens-studio.json with the Tokens Studio plugin, or recreate variables from docs/figma-build-plan.md. Colours are 0..1 RGBA. NOT verified against a live Figma file.

variables.name: palette/sun
variables.description: Grass-line yellow. Used like a highlighter.

variables.name: fixed/receipt-paper
variables.description: Receipt face. Site uses surface-container-lowest, which turns near-black in dark; DS pins it to paper.

variables.name: md-sys-color/highlight-on-primary
variables.description: Custom role: marker-yellow accent on a primary (cobalt) panel: step numbers, section numerals.

variables.name: md-sys-color/on-primary-muted
variables.description: Custom role: secondary text on a primary panel (the site uses primary-container for this).

variables.name: md-sys-color/sun-outline
variables.description: Custom role: rule/outline used on sun-container panels (dashed fact lines).

variables.name: family/display
variables.description: Fraunces: headlines, numerals, drawer links. Uses SOFT and WONK axes.

variables.name: family/body
variables.description: Body copy, buttons, form input text.

variables.name: family/hand
variables.description: Margin notes only. Never for essential content.

variables.name: size/display-large
variables.description: Figma value is the max (desktop) size in px; min = 2.75rem

variables.name: size/headline-large
variables.description: Figma value is the max (desktop) size in px; min = 2.1rem

variables.name: size/headline-medium
variables.description: Figma value is the max (desktop) size in px; min = 1.6rem

variables.name: size/lead
variables.description: Figma value is the max (desktop) size in px; min = undefined

variables.name: size/caption
variables.description: Mono captions under photos. Site uses .6-.66rem; the DS raises the floor to 11px. Never use for essential text.
